Class ActionsDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.dto.ActionsDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ActionsDTO extends Object implements Serializable
Carries the set of actions still available to the active player for the current turn.

Sent by the server whenever the player's action count changes.
